variant.displayName: DEAD SAINTS -- Rank, Scale Cargo Run
variant.briefing:
If you're looking for creds, the Saints need someone with hauling experience to do a supply run from [Location] to [Destination]. 

You're gonna need a ship that can hold size [MissionMaxSCUSize] cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam to move the boxes around. 

Don't open the crates but just so you know, most of this stuff is legal but not all of it. Try not to cross paths with anyone who might make that a problem for you. Get me?

-Twitch
variant.prerequisiteSummary: Rookie / 50 rep to Master / 237,750 rep; CrimeStat limited to 2 or below; Pyro
